Dana (CS Ops): quick note - several onboarding tenants hit timeouts during bulk document upload this morning. need short customer-facing status + plan for credits and a live Q&A.
Liam (Platform Eng): root cause looks like upload coordinator contention when many parallel multipart uploads start at once; coordinator queue stalled. pushed a backpressure patch at 2025-01-07T11:05Z.
Yuna (SRE): impact window 10:50-11:20 UTC, timeout spike ~8%. we scaled ingestion workers and suppressed retries; error rate down to ~0.9% now.
Dana (CS Ops): draft outbound (keep tight): "Hi — we experienced intermittent onboarding timeouts for some bulk uploads this morning. Status: a fix is deployed and we're monitoring a 24h canary. Next: we'll roll the fix wide if metrics stay stable and apply a one-time onboarding credit to affected accounts automatically. We will host a 30m live Q&A tomorrow; recording will be posted. Support: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-help"
Hector (Acct Mgmt): can renewals team get a list of impacted trials? i want to reach out to two accounts at risk.
Dana (CS Ops): yes — i'll DM the list to renewals. credit policy approved by product: one-time automatic credit per affected tenant. Ops to queue credits within 48h.
Liam (Platform Eng): follow-ups for RCA: 1) add queue-length alert for coordinator 2) synthetic test for parallel multipart bursts 3) deploy a non-blocking enqueue metric.
Yuna (SRE): action items: 1) dashboard panel for impacted tenants 2) playbook step to temporarily raise worker count during ingestion windows 3) 72h runbook checks post-rollout.
Dana (CS Ops): office hours: scheduled tomorrow 14:00 UTC (30m). Dana will host CS, Liam + Yuna join for tech Q&A. OpsBot create event and incident.
OpsBot: Event created: "Bulk upload impact Q&A" — 2025-01-08T14:00:00Z. Incident: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2025-0017. Recording will be attached.
Hector (Acct Mgmt): thanks — please ping me when you post the impacted tenant list. ill draft a tailored note for the two renewal-risk accounts.
Dana (CS Ops): legal check requested; will send outbound after legal thumbs-up. please react with :white_check_mark: when youve reviewed the customer copy.
Liam (Platform Eng): :white_check_mark:
